prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI feedback preparation loading concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for state, background, and UI purpose only.
Primary request: Redesign 13-D-M2-ai-analysis-loading/analyzing.
Direction: feedback preparation room.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Keep submitted answer workspace dimmed behind a centered modal. Modal should show a compact monochrome AI mark, analysis-in-progress title, estimated wait, progress percentage, four labeled stages, current stage explanation, and one quiet secondary action to leave or cancel.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Modal, Progress, Steps, Alert UI; dense but readable TOPIK study tool.

Typography: Cosmica-like single sans typography, weight-based hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: loading state must not look complete; avoid fake scores or feedback content; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, blue/purple AI glow, loud gradients, animated streak effects, colorful CTA buttons, giant mascot, watermark.
